headline: French Industrial Producer Prices Rise 9.6% Year-on-Year in October
summary: French industrial producer prices increased by 9.6% over the twelve months to October, indicating sustained upstream cost pressures.
why: Producer price inflation serves as a leading indicator for consumer price trends, influencing central bank monetary policy evaluations.

impacts.name: France
impacts.why: High industrial producer inflation reflects increasing cost burdens in the manufacturing sector.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
